archetypes.name: dyn-manifest-wire
archetypes.rationale: Run-log manifest v2 reserved-key behavior is subtle and disk-format-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the run_logs.py manifest changes for byte and key preservation risks. Focus on Manifest.from_json/to_json, reserved versus extra routing, update_manifest, _update_manifest_v2, recovery, and verify-completeness paths. Check that v2 files never regain v1 keys and that pr_number, issue_number, and stalled_at_step survive updates. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-finding-parser
archetypes.rationale: Finding block boundary semantics differ by caller and can silently alter review output.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new review_types parser adoption in review_and_fix.py and review_aggregate.py. Focus on heading-inclusive blocks, any-heading versus finding-heading boundaries, preamble preservation, OOS filtering, and nit-count semantics. Check for unchanged markdown output and UTF-8 tolerant reads. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
